resolution.title: Add a reviewed DESeq2 analysis adapter
resolution.detail: A count table and design string are not enough to define a DESeq2 analysis. Somite retains this method without pretending that a placeholder R expression produces valid results.

recipes.title: Build a tested DESeq2 analysis
recipes.summary: Define sample metadata, the design formula, contrasts, filtering, and emitted result tables as one reviewed contract.
steps: Attach a sample metadata table whose rows match the count matrix columns.
Record the exact design formula, contrasts, and filtering choices.
Run a representative fixture and verify the emitted result schema before accepting the adapter.
